title: Colorability under vertex relabeling
statement: Let $v,q$ be natural numbers, let $G$ assign a Boolean value to each two-element subset of the $v$ vertices, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of the vertices. The graph obtained by relabeling $G$ by $\sigma$ admits a proper coloring with $q$ colors if and only if $G$ admits a proper coloring with $q$ colors.
